title: copilot-proxy-rs: config.toml decides failed-request body logging under process-compose
prompt:
The owner set `log_failed_request_bodies = true` in ~/.config/copilot-proxy-rs/config.toml and restarted the managed proxy, but failed-request bodies are still not logged. Cause (verified): process-compose.yaml (added in #58) sets the env var `COPILOT_PROXY_RS_LOG_FAILED_REQUEST_BODIES=false` for the proxy process, and env overrides beat the config file (src/config.rs apply_env_overrides -> apply_bool). tests/process_compose_contract.rs requires that line. The code default is already true, and an unset or empty env var leaves the file value in place (apply_bool ignores values that are not a boolean).

Goal: under process-compose, config.toml decides failed-request body logging; an explicit env var still overrides it.
1. Remove the hard-coded `COPILOT_PROXY_RS_LOG_FAILED_REQUEST_BODIES=false` from process-compose.yaml (or pass it through only when the caller sets it, e.g. `${COPILOT_PROXY_RS_LOG_FAILED_REQUEST_BODIES:-}`; choose the simplest that keeps the env override working and say why).
2. Update tests/process_compose_contract.rs: assert the line no longer forces a value. Add config tests: file true + env unset -> true; file true + env empty -> true; file true + env false -> false; no file -> default true.
3. Check the rest of process-compose.yaml, mise.toml and scripts/proxy-compose.sh for any other env value that silently overrides a config.toml key; list them in the PR body (fix only this one unless another one is clearly a bug of the same kind, then ask).
4. README: one line on precedence (env over config.toml over defaults) and that process-compose no longer forces failed-body logging off.
5. cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test --locked pass with no Cargo.lock change.
6. Proof on port 18080, started the same way process-compose starts it but on 18080 (COPILOT_PROXY_RS_PORT=18080, COPILOT_PROXY_RS_CONFIG_DIR=$HOME/.config/copilot-proxy-rs so the real config.toml is read in place; never copy a token or config file, the shell refuses it): send one request that fails upstream (e.g. an unknown model through /v1/chat/completions) and show the `failed request body` (or equivalent) log line appears; then run once with COPILOT_PROXY_RS_LOG_FAILED_REQUEST_BODIES=false and show it does not. Redact the body content in the PR; show only that the line exists and its field names. Put this under "Proof".
- Never touch, stop or bind the live proxy on 8080 (the owner restarts it after merge). Do not log tokens. Keep research notes and scratch files out of the PR and out of the repo root: put them under .factory/.
- This is a repeatable factory test: other open PRs for related work are earlier runs. Ignore them and build a new PR.
